---
title: "raisin_river_read"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

url <- "https://paddlestats.net/json/r/RAISIN/2025/2015"
rr_results <- read_json(url, simplifyVector = TRUE)
rr_results <- as.data.frame(rr_results)
rr_results <- rr_results |> unnest_longer(results.paddlers)
rr_results <- as.data.frame(rr_results)

rr_results <- rr_results |> select(results.year, results.boatType, results.bib, results.classId, results.value, results.courseId, results.notes, results.paddlers, results.status)

rr_results <- rr_results |> mutate( rename(year = results.year, boatType = results.boatType, bib = results.bib, classID = results.classId, time = results.value, courseID = results.courseId, notes = results.notes, paddlers = results.paddlers, status = results.status) )

```

```{r}


rr_classes <- rr_results |> group_by(results.classId) |> filter (results.value != 0) summarise(avg_time = mean(results.value)) |> arrange(avg_time)

ggplot(rr_classes, aes(x = results.classId, y = results.value)) +
  geom_boxplot()

```

```{r}
rr_year_avg <- rr_results |> group_by(results.year) |> filter (results.year != 2017) |> summarise(mean_time = mean(results.value))
```


```{r}
flow = read_csv("phoebechar/raisin_river/RRflow - Sheet1.csv")

```

```{r}
rr_results_flow <- full_join(rr_year_avg, flow)

rr_results_flow |> filter(results.year != 2017)

ggplot(rr_results_flow, aes(x = mean_time, y = flow)) +
  geom_point()

```
